Methods & data

Trust begins with
showing the work.

This first build demonstrates Citynario’s calculation and provenance contract. Its rates are illustrative proxies—not locally validated findings.

MODEL 01

Resident estimate

Bedroom-specific occupancy rates, an explicit vacancy allowance, and low / central / high assumptions.

MODEL 02

School enrollment

Bedroom-specific student yields, separated from any claim about school assignment or capacity.

MODEL 03

Mobility screening

Person-trip rates adjusted by parking supply and transit context—never assigned to a specific street.

MODEL 04

Site context

Proposed land cover compared with a demonstration baseline and mapped environmental flags.
